en.text:
Requires <arc/>Stormtrance to be equipped to function.

Casting your Super grants <arc/>Amplified.

While <arc/>Amplified, <arc/>Arc Ability Hits grant x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge. 0.6 second cooldown between activations.

Hits and Kills during <arc/>Stormtrance grant a Stack of 'Ascending Amplitude' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 30 Stacks.

Ascending Amplitude:
• Decreases the Super Energy cost of <arc/>Stormtrance's Ionic Blink by 50% (6.25%🠚3.125%).
• Increases <arc/>Stormtrance's damage by 6.7% per Stack, up to 200% bonus damage at maximum stacks.

Refunds up to 30% of Super Energy based on the number of enemies killed with your Super.
